faq.q: What is the best boat for a Marbella Pride 2032 yacht charter?
faq.a: For a lively group, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) is a top choice—it includes a free jet ski and departs from Puerto Banús. For smaller parties, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 guests) offers great value from €749 for 2 hours. All boats come with a skipper and refreshments.

faq.q: How much does a yacht charter cost for Marbella Pride 2032?
faq.a: Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), or €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80 start at €4,719 for 4 hours, including a jet ski. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras—just bring your party spirit.

faq.q: Can I bring my own decorations or music for Pride?
faq.a: Yes, you're welcome to bring decorations, rainbow flags, and your own playlist (most boats have Bluetooth or AUX). Just keep it safe and respectful of the boat. Our skipper can advise on what works best.

faq.q: Where will we sail during the Marbella Pride charter?
faq.a: You can choose your route: cruise along the Golden Mile, anchor at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, or head to Cabopino or Estepona. The skipper will tailor the trip to your preferences, weather permitting.

faq.q: How do I book a yacht for Marbella Pride 2032?
faq.a: Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability and get a personalised quote. We recommend booking at least 4–6 weeks in advance, as Pride week is very popular. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: Is there a minimum number of guests for a charter?
faq.a: No minimum—you can book for as few as 5 guests on the Dubhe speedboat or Mariah SX21. Most boats accommodate up to 12 guests. The price is per boat, not per person.

faq.q: What if the weather is bad on the day of my Pride charter?
faq.a: Safety comes first. If conditions are unsafe, we'll reschedule or offer a full refund. The skipper will make the call on the day. Most June days in Marbella are sunny with calm seas.

data.body_html:
Marbella Pride 2032 is set to be the biggest celebration on the Costa del Sol, and there's no better way to join the party than from the deck of a private yacht. Departing from iconic Puerto Banús, our fleet offers boats for groups of 5 to 12 guests, with everything included: skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. Whether you want a two-hour sunset cruise or a full-day adventure along the coast, a Marbella Pride 2032 yacht charter lets you celebrate in style, with the Mediterranean as your backdrop.

Why Choose a Yacht Charter for Marbella Pride 2032?

Pride in Marbella is a week-long festival of colour, music, and inclusivity. By chartering a private yacht, you skip the crowded bars and beach clubs for a floating VIP experience. You control the music, the route, and the crowd. Anchor at a quiet cove for a swim, or cruise past the mansions of the Golden Mile while sipping cava. Our boats depart from Puerto Banús, putting you right in the centre of the action, yet free to escape whenever you like.

Our Fleet for Marbella Pride 2032

We have over 15 boats available, from nimble speedboats to superyachts. All depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper. Here are the most popular choices for Pride celebrations:

Pricing and Inclusions for Pride Charters

All prices include Spanish IVA (21%), a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. No hidden fees. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) start at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter, with a jet ski included free of charge. For other boats, including the Ferretti 94, Canados 86, or K80, pricing is available via WhatsApp—just ask.

Suggested Itineraries for Pride Day

Your skipper will tailor the route to your wishes, but here are three popular options for a Pride charter:

  • Golden Mile Cruise: Sail past Marbella's most exclusive beach clubs and villas, with a stop for photos off La Concha mountain. Perfect for a short 2-hour trip.
  • Cala del Faro & Cala Cortés: Anchor in these turquoise coves for swimming, paddleboarding, and lunch. A 4-hour charter is ideal.
  • Cabopino or Estepona: Head east to the dunes of Cabopino or west to Estepona's marina for a longer day out. Best with an 8-hour charter.

What to Bring for Your Pride Yacht Charter

Pack swimwear, sunscreen, a towel, and sunglasses. You're welcome to bring rainbow flags, decorations, and your own playlist—most boats have Bluetooth speakers. If you want to upgrade the snacks or bring a cake, let us know in advance. The boat is your private space, so feel free to personalise it.

How to Book Your Marbella Pride 2032 Yacht Charter

Booking is simple. Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and duration. We'll confirm availability and send a quote. For Pride week, we recommend booking 4–6 weeks ahead. All charters depart from Puerto Banús, with easy parking and taxi access. Ready to celebrate? Reserve your Marbella yacht charter today.
